name: grandma-devkit
description: Write Lua plugins for grandMA3 and grandMA2: API completion, hover and signature help, lint checks, plugin scaffolding, one-command deploy, and run-on-console through a LuaBridge.

commands.title: Run File or Selection on Console
Send Selected Lines to Console as Commands (Telnet)

ma3.target.markdownDescription: Which console a Lua file is written for. `auto` picks grandMA2 when the code calls `gma.*` or the plugin's manifest is a grandMA2 one (`<MA ...>`), and grandMA3 otherwise.

ma3.telnet.host.description: Host of the console's Telnet command line (grandMA2). Telnet (the remote command line) must be enabled on the console.

ma3.telnet.monitorPort.description: Telnet System Monitor port (Lua runtime errors and console messages).

ma3.telnet.user.description: User profile to log in as over Telnet, for example a dedicated testing user. Many profiles have no password; if yours does, use Set Telnet Password (kept in VS Code's secret storage, never in settings).

ma3.telnet.gapMs.description: Pause between Telnet commands in milliseconds; the console drops lines when they arrive faster.

ma3.deployAndRun.via.markdownDescription: How **Deploy and Reload on Console** reaches grandMA2: `auto` uses the LuaBridge when it is running and Telnet otherwise.

ma3.bridge.slot.markdownDescription: Plugin pool slot **Install LuaBridge on Console** suggests for LuaBridge_MA2 (0 means 99).

ma3.ma2.pluginsPath.markdownDescription: Folder grandMA2 loads plugin files from. Empty uses the newest `%ProgramData%/MA Lighting Technologies/grandma/gma2_V_<version>/plugins` on Windows.

ma3.ma2.bridgeDir.markdownDescription: Folder the grandMA2 LuaBridge_MA2 plugin polls. Empty uses `%ProgramData%/MA2/luabridge` (or the `MA2_LUABRIDGE_DIR` environment variable). Use onPC with a throwaway show.

ma3.ma2.version.description: grandMA2 software version written into new grandMA2 plugin manifests (major.minor.stream).

ma3.pluginsPath.markdownDescription: Folder the console loads plugin files from. Empty uses `%ProgramData%/MALightingTechnology/gma3_library/datapools/plugins` on Windows; set it on other systems or for a USB stick.

ma3.deployOnSave.description: Copy a plugin's files to the plugins folder whenever one of its .lua or .xml files is saved.

ma3.deployAndRun.slot.markdownDescription: Plugin pool slot that **Deploy and Reload on Console** imports the plugin into and starts, through the LuaBridge plugin. 0 only deploys. Use onPC with a throwaway show: the slot is overwritten.

ma3.dataVersion.description: DataVersion written into new plugin XML manifests.

ma3.bridge.dir.markdownDescription: Folder the LuaBridge plugin polls. Empty uses `%ProgramData%/MA3/luabridge` (or the `MA3_LUABRIDGE_DIR` environment variable). Run only against onPC with a throwaway show: anything that can write this folder can run Lua in grandMA3.

ma3.bridge.timeout.markdownDescription: Seconds of CPU time a run may use before the bridge stops it. The console UI is frozen for that long, and time spent in `coroutine.yield` counts.

ma3.liveCompletion.markdownDescription: Inside `Cmd("...")` strings, complete group, sequence, macro, preset and similar numbers with the labels from the show running in onPC, through the LuaBridge plugin. The lookup takes a few milliseconds of console time, at most once a minute, and only while the bridge is running.

ma3.lint.globals.description: Hint when a variable is assigned without "local" and so becomes a global shared with every plugin.

ma3.diagnostics.description: Check plugin manifests and flag loops that never yield.
